yc548f072c32.add: - **NGTS-4b** ('forbidden planet', 2019): a **Neptune-sized** exoplanet found in the **'Neptunian desert'** close to its star, where such planets were thought unable to survive.

y98a4388933f.add: - **Jupiter's rings:** faint rings of fine **dust (silicate/rocky particles)** knocked off its small inner moons – not gases.

ye9b860fae80.add: - **No air on the Moon:** there is **no atmosphere / no oxygen**, so nothing can burn there, sound does not travel and the sky is black.

y4a2e19e2928.add: - **Diamond ring:** beads of sunlight shining through valleys on the Moon's rugged edge just **before and after totality**; UPSC 1996 key (PMF): seen **only along the peripheral regions of the totality trail**.

ydc5bfcb1321.add: - **Totality only in a narrow path:** the **Moon's shadow (umbra) on the Earth is small**, so a total solar eclipse is seen only along a narrow **path of totality**.

y23a55b9058f.add: - **Sea of Tranquility** (Mare Tranquillitatis): a dark lava plain (mare) on the **Moon**; Apollo 11 landed there (1969).

yb0c43eca7d1.add: - **Escape velocity:** Earth **11.2 km/s** (Moon ~2.4 km/s); orbital velocity near Earth ~7.9 km/s.

y30f687075ad.add: - **Moonlight reaches Earth in ~1.3 seconds** (384,400 km ÷ 3 × 10⁵ km/s).

yc17dd202d8a.add: - **Google AI + NASA Kepler data (December 2017):** machine learning found **Kepler-90i** (making Kepler-90 the first 8-planet system like ours) and **Kepler-80g**.

ya8be3f06fd7.add: - **Last man on the Moon:** **Eugene Cernan**, Apollo 17 (December 1972); 12 men in all walked on it (Artemis II, 2026, was a flyby, no landing).

y61fd55ab099.add: - **Rosetta / Philae (ESA):** first landing on a comet, **67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko**, 12 November 2014 – to study whether comets brought **water and organic matter** to Earth.

y02d1bb32e1e.add: - **Cosmic dust:** tiny solid particles of matter spread throughout space (interplanetary and interstellar dust).

ydc9a3680571.add: - **Juno (NASA):** Jupiter orbiter (launched 2011, in orbit since 2016) – atmosphere, magnetic field, interior.

y9ab19147ed5.add: - **NASA centres:** **Jet Propulsion Laboratory – Pasadena** (California); Johnson Space Center – Houston; Kennedy Space Center – Cape Canaveral.

y246a3a7a22d.add: - **Evolved LISA (eLISA, ESA):** planned gravitational-wave observatory – **three spacecraft in an equilateral triangle** with ~1 million km sides, linked by lasers (UPSC 2020); LISA Pathfinder was only the test craft.

y9a7ce50ce20.add: - **Magellan (NASA):** radar mapper of **Venus** (launched 4 May 1989, orbit from August 1990).

y6728ef484d8.add: - **Kepler space telescope (NASA, 2009-2018):** searched for **Earth-like (Earth-size) planets** in the habitable zone of other stars by the transit method.

y2f8fc1d7546.add: - **Deep Space Atomic Clock (NASA):** launched into **space** (Earth orbit) on 25 June 2019 to test atomic timekeeping for deep-space navigation.
